summary: MCGS Phase 2 v1.1 freeze-baseline regression sweep — BACKEND ONLY. All 26 checks from /app/test_result.md pass (27/27 pytest runs incl. teardown, 79s). Coverage: (A) Phase 1 regression — CMS login token/admin shape, counts, signals?priority=P0, cases, prompt-injection 12/12 classifier + 12/12 George behaviour (subprocess). (B) Rhythm settings — merged-defaults GET, valid PUT returns 200, invalid time '7am' returns 400, scheduler reflects updated morning-weekday to 07:15. (C) Morning briefing — compose?force=true returns opener_line / recommendation / recommendation_heading / content_markdown / grounded_sources.local_now; second call (no force) returns same id; today endpoint lists it; seen sets bridge_seen_at then no-ops; acknowledge sets bridge_acknowledged_at. (D) Midday — force-eval with no material change returns {status:'skipped', skip_reason:'no_material_change'}, no persistence; after seeding a P1 test signal directly in db.mcgs_signals with created_at > morning.delivered_at, force-eval FIRES with heading/opener_line/recommendation/recommendation_heading. (E) EOD — compose?force=true returns opener_line/today_line/sign_off_line and opener_used at top level; unresolved_carryover key present top-level; re-composing morning respects continuity when carryover set. (F) Delivery — with bridge_seen_at reset, morning email=='delivered' (Resend live) + push=='skipped_no_linked_mobile_user' (acceptable); after /seen, both channels==skipped_seen_on_bridge OR already_delivered; midday deliver returns email=='not_in_policy'. (G) Milestones — scan returns {paused,awarded,count}, second call idempotent (count==0), unique index on (milestone_key,period_key) present. (H) Scheduler — running:true with morning-weekday/morning-weekend/midday/eod/milestones.scan jobs; per-admin next_run_at carries Australia/Melbourne offset (+10:00 AEST). Cleanup: producer=test signals removed at end. Report v1.1 freeze BASELINE CONFIRMED.

minor.issue: Route referenced in /app/test_result.md §A2 does not exist. Deployed Phase 1 endpoint is GET /api/mcgs/counts and returns counts by state ({signals:{open,new,in_review}, cases:{open}, per_producer}), NOT by priority. Endpoint itself is healthy — this is a test-spec vs deployed-implementation drift. Recommend updating /app/test_result.md §A2 OR adding a /api/mcgs/signals/counts alias if by-priority counts are needed.

Baseline doc /app/memory/phase2-baseline-v1.1.md and test_result.md §B6 both call out eod_inactivity_wait_minutes default of 30. Current live admin (hello@friendplace.com.au) has a persisted override of 25 from an earlier session. Endpoint correctly merges default + override — no code issue — but if v1.1 sign-off requires the freeze value, either delete the mcgs_rhythm_settings doc for this admin or PUT it back to 30 before shipping.
